label: Cisco Meraki MR46
description: Cloud-managed dual-radio 802.11ax AP with 4x4:4 on both 2.4 and 5 GHz (2.98 Gbps aggregate), plus dedicated WIDS/WIPS and BLE radios. It has a single 100/1000/2.5GBASE-T RJ45 port with 802.3at PoE-in and two client-serving radios (2.4 and 5 GHz).
notes: Only one Ethernet port - no second RJ45 and no USB. The third (WIDS/WIPS + spectrum) and fourth (BLE) radios are management radios, not client-serving bands, so they are not modelled as wireless interfaces. Needs a 2.5G switch port to avoid capping the 4x4 radios.
